sources.entry: Surge - Web developer tool and proxy utility for iOS 9.

summary.name: Surge
summary.one_liner: Surge is a network toolbox and high-performance proxy client that routes device traffic through rules and supports many proxy protocols, with a built-in HTTP debugging dashboard.
use_cases: route device traffic through proxy servers
debug HTTP and HTTPS requests in real time
map responses to local data for testing
summary.what_it_does: Surge takes over the network traffic of a device and routes each request through a flexible rule system. It forwards traffic over many proxy protocols, including HTTP/2 CONNECT, MASQUE, Trust Tunnel, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Snell, Hysteria 2, WireGuard, Tailscale, and SSH. It also customizes DNS behavior along the way. With the Dashboard, it monitors requests in real time and decrypts HTTPS traffic. Users can rewrite requests and responses, map responses to local data, and extend behavior with JavaScript.
notable: Rule-based routing across many proxy protocols including WireGuard, Tailscale, and Hysteria 2
Built-in HTTP debugging dashboard with real-time request monitoring and HTTPS decryption
Request/response rewriting, map local, and JavaScript extensions
